day_shape: 99 items: Trump signals a US-Iran deal could be signed this weekend in Europe with reported $12bn unfreezing, IDF advances past Litani toward Nabatieh with 310 Hezbollah targets struck this week, Iran FM spokesman Bagheri says nothing is finalised, no UK Parliament or OFAC items.

threads.label: US-Iran deal signalled, Tehran hedges
threads.summary: Trump said a US-Iran agreement could be signed this weekend in Europe after calling off strikes, with Mehr reporting the package includes a Lebanon ceasefire and initial unfreezing of $12bn. Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said nothing is finalised and accused Washington of shifting positions, while Qatar and Pakistan are described as active mediators.

threads.label: IDF advances in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck around 310 Hezbollah targets and eliminated about 80 operatives over the past week, completed a raid on Dibbine 12km north of the border, and is poised for an offensive on Nabatieh after advancing past the Litani toward the Zaharani. Troops cleared a tunnel network near Beaufort Castle, while Defa Press claimed Hezbollah carried out 24 operations including a Merkava strike near Tyre Harfa.

threads.label: Hormuz, Kharg and water infrastructure
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported a US strike on a drinking water reservoir near the Strait of Hormuz cutting supply to about 20,000 residents, with CENTCOM saying it is reviewing reports and that the Strait remains open for transit. Iranian outlets warned of petrol rationing tied to Hormuz conditions, the Hanzalah group claimed it hacked California water facilities in retaliation, and Times of Israel reported expert commentary on a potential US seizure of Kharg Island.

threads.label: Iran diplomacy and Western pushback
threads.summary: IRIB reported a call between Foreign Minister Araghchi and France's Jean-Noël Barrot on regional developments and Pakistani mediation, while deputy FM Gharibabadi rejected a joint statement by several countries on Iran's alleged threatening activities as baseless. The Jerusalem Post reported a UAE-Iran security chiefs meeting, the first face-to-face since the war.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and resistance framing
threads.summary: Khamenei's office circulated a 14 Khordad message saying the hegemonic system has a problem with Iran's distinctive identity, and announced a mourning ceremony for Ayatollah Fiayd in Qom led by the Supreme Leader. Defa Press carried statements from the armed forces' ideological-political chief saying Iran has never threatened any country, alongside book and exhibition coverage tying current resistance to Ashura.

threads.label: Gaza, West Bank and Hamas detentions
threads.summary: Hamas co-founder Hassan Yousef, 71, was released from Israeli administrative detention after 2.5 years, sirens sounded over Nahal Oz and Alumim, and Times of Israel reported mediators are pessimistic about a Gaza breakthrough before Israeli autumn elections. Islamic Jihad claimed responsibility for a Jenin attack wounding two Israeli soldiers, and Greece ordered an alleged Hamas operative detained pending trial.

threads.label: Iran-linked US legal and deportation cases
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the Trump administration plans to deport Iranians and other migrants to the Central African Republic, including two women said to face torture risk if returned to Iran. A dual US-Iranian citizen is set for bail release before trial over a deadly drone attack on a US base in Jordan, and a Toronto officer died searching for suspects tied to a US consulate shooting linked to an Iranian proxy group.

events.title_en: The Morning of the Tenth Day: a book about the continuation of Ashura's red line
events.summary_en: The book The Morning of the Tenth Day by Hojjat al-Islam Sayed Mohammad Hossein Raji is a work that, focusing on Ashuri elements in the life and path of the martyred leader of the Islamic Revolution, seeks to narrate the link between Ashuri culture and contemporary experiences of struggle and resistance. In this book, the author, by referring to ten Ashuri characteristics, revisits concepts such as sincerity, courage, sacrifice, dignity, striving and indifference to the world in the life and path of the martyred leader of the revolution, and analysed these concepts in line with the school of Imam Hussein. The Morning of the Tenth Day is a narrative of the continuation of the Ashuri line in contemporary history; a path that begins with the event of Karbala.

events.title: Prediction Markets; Public Interest Determinations
events.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (Commission or CFTC) is proposing amendments to its rules concerning event contract derivatives. The markets for these event contracts are commonly referred to as "prediction markets." In particular, the Commission is proposing amendments to further specify the types of event contracts that may be subject to a determination that they are contrary to the public interest, such that they may not be listed for trading or accepted for clearing on or through a CFTC-registered entity, as provided in the Commodity Exchange Act (CEA). The proposed amendments set out factors the Commission would apply in that determination and conform the process by which the determination would be made to the CEA. The Commission also is proposing amendments to the procedure for the Commission's determination to enhance clarity and organization, as well as a definition of the term "gaming" and a rule regarding when event contracts "involve" an underlying activity.
